- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10207 (line lacks numeric validation of MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY in dynamic comparison) | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603]
  PROBLEM: The streak comparison relies on MAX_JUDGE_REPLAY being a valid integer without a local runtime guard.
  WHY: One reviewer reported startup validation elsewhere, but the compare site itself was still flagged as lacking a numeric guard and can misbehave if the value is empty or malformed.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10415-10455 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The streak-update persistence path uses non-atomic jq-to-temp-file-and-mv writes.
  WHY: Partial writes, concurrent judge attempts, or disk-full failures can lose or truncate the escalation streak state.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:10198-10213 | severity=high | confidence=5
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: Scratch-file creation failure leaves the function fail-open with `_judge_state_file_ready=false` and no fallback.
  WHY: When temp-file creation fails, the backstop is silently disabled instead of retrying or using the standalone marker.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11705-11712 | severity=low | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: `STALL_JUDGE_STATE_FILE_OVERRIDE` is exported/transiently leaked from `run_standalone_stall_recovery` without proper encapsulation.
  WHY: Child subprocesses or later code can inherit and accidentally consume the override.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:1618-1625,11705-11712 | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [mistralai_mistral-small-2603, x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The new `STALL_JUDGE_STATE_FILE_OVERRIDE` environment variable is not listed in the canonical variable-description table.
  WHY: Operators cannot discover or validate its purpose, defaults, or scope from the documented config surface.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:11705-11715 (run_stall_judge case in run_standalone_stall_recovery) | severity=low | confidence=3
  flagged_by: [qwen_qwen3_6-plus]
  PROBLEM: `STALL_JUDGE_STATE_FILE_OVERRIDE` is set even when the seed `printf` fails, so a deleted temp path can be recreated as blank state and overwrite the accumulated streak.
  WHY: A transient seed-write failure can reset the counter and corrupt the caller's state for the next tick.
- scripts/orchestrate_poll_process.sh:~10415-10432 and ~11705-11715 | severity=high | confidence=4
  flagged_by: [x-ai_grok-4_20]
  PROBLEM: The standalone scratch-file round-trip can silently lose sibling keys when the slurpfile sync fails.
  WHY: The temp file is deleted at the end of the poll cycle and only `.judge_escalate_streak` is round-tripped, so parse errors or mid-pipeline failures can drop state.
=== END CONSENSUS FINDINGS ===
